title: Cobblemon Assets Backport
description: Backports upcoming Cobblemon assets for use in your current world.
body:
# Cobblemon Assets Backport This addon adds Pokémon from the official Cobblemon mod that have not been fully released in the current stable version yet. > **Note:** This pack **ONLY** provides new Pokémon models, textures, animations, and riding configurations + Move animations from Cobblemon itself. It does **NOT** include or support other mechanical changes (such as blocks, items, or gameplay mechanics). --- ### Supported Versions * Current Version: Cobblemon **1.8** assets backported to **1.7.x**

--- ## Installation Guide Since this pack functions as **both a Resourcepack and a Datapack in a single file**, the Modrinth launcher cannot install it automatically. Please follow the instructions below: ### For Singleplayer 1. Put the downloaded `.zip` file into `/saves/[WORLDNAME]/datapacks` 2. Put the same `.zip` file into `/resourcepacks` 3. Enable the resourcepack in-game. ### For Servers 1. Put the `.zip` file into `/world/datapacks` on your server files. 2. Ensure **EVERY** player has this pack enabled as a resourcepack on their client. --- ## FAQ & Troubleshooting Q. **Where can I get help or report a bug?** * Please visit the [Official Cobblemon Discord](https://discord.com/invite/cobblemon) and look for [this](https://discord.com/channels/934267676354834442/1512871035391709367) channel. Q. **My game crashes after installing this addon.** * This usually indicates a datapack or addon conflict. Try removing conflicting assets/data from this addon. Q. **Some Pokémon do not have proper animations.** * This is not a bug or a conflict. It simply means the animations have not been fully implemented yet by the original developers. Please wait for future updates! **Limitations (Things I cannot provide support for)** : * General troubleshooting for custom modpacks and server setups. * Complaints regarding the quality of animations or models (I did not create them). --- ## Credits & License Note * This addon uses asset models from the official **Cobblemon** project. * All shared assets comply with the [Cobblemon Fair Use Policy](https://cobblemon.com/en/fairuse). * Special thanks to **the Cobblemon team** for allowing the community to utilize these assets for non-commercial project building!
